motion_principles.core_rule: Purposeful motion > excessive motion. Motion should improve understanding, hierarchy, attention, and perceived responsiveness without causing visual clutter or slow load times.

hover_card.effect: translateY(-4px) + box-shadow elevation + border color shift

animated_counter.effect: Numeric count up from 0 to target value over 1.2 seconds using requestAnimationFrame with easeOutExpo.

kinetic_typography.effect: Words slide in sequentially with staggered clip-path reveal.

accessibility_reduced_motion.rule: Every animated component must support prefers-reduced-motion: reduce CSS media query.
